verdict.rationale: llamafile documents fully offline local inference, a chat Web UI and image upload, but nothing in the pack shows built-in document ingestion or automatic retrieval-augmented generation. The only document-chat reference is a community comment saying users must set up a separate Python/LlamaIndex install, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation
